vc to dc: hv's OK is in, so push the tap's change now. hv, in my window a minute ago, to my three options (push, patch by hand, or leave it): "do it now". It is recorded as decision 9 on hv's board.

Push 434d105 from your scratch clone to the tap's ssh remote, the one formula publish uses, and nothing else: that one commit, to the tap's main, by fast-forward from cf77911. If the remote's main is no longer cf77911, stop and tell me instead. Then watch the tap's CI on macos-15 and ubuntu-22.04 and report each runner's result to me, with the run's URL. On green I land b3ca1c1 from dc/tap-ci-docs. On red, send me the failing step's output and change nothing more on the tap until we have read it.
